meta.idea_raw: AI tool for restaurant menu optimization

target_user.demographics: Professionals in food & restaurant, 25-45, urban, mid-income
target_user.psychographics: Time-constrained, wants efficiency, willing to pay for solutions

brief.pain_statement: People in food & restaurant waste time and money on manual processes that this tool can automate.

market_size.sam: food & restaurant professionals needing this specific solution (~$500M)

brief.unique_value_prop: AI-powered tool that solves the core food & restaurant problem faster and cheaper than existing solutions, with zero setup time.

mvp_scope.core_feature: Core food & restaurant problem solver — one screen, one action, immediate value

go_to_market.launch_strategy: Launch on Product Hunt with a free tier, convert to paid via value demonstration

risk_factors: Competitive food & restaurant market — need strong differentiation
User acquisition cost may exceed initial pricing
Technical complexity of AI features may delay MVP

next_steps.f1_product_builder: Run f1_product_builder.py with this brief to create implementation plan
next_steps.f2_business_strategist: Run f2_business_strategist.py to deepen market analysis
next_steps.f3_communication_manager: Run f3_communication_manager.py to plan launch comms
